project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-style library management app with loans, holds, fees, reports and library info modules using repository/service/composition layering.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Defines SystemClock, a thin wrapper over Django's timezone-aware local date used to supply 'today' to loan logic.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation returning the current local date via django.utils.timezone.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires the Django repository and system clock into a shared LoanApplication instance.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django ModelForm for lending a book, validating that member and ISBN are non-blank while preserving raw input.

nodes.name: LoanForm
nodes.summary: ModelForm over Loan with member and isbn fields, rejecting whitespace-only values.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for a Loan, with a computed due date 14 days after lending.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: Loan entity with member, isbn, lent_on and optional returned_on; due_on is derived as lent_on + 14 days.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed loan repository implementing lookup, creation and transactional return marking.

nodes.name: DjangoLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Implements the LoanRepository protocol using Loan.objects, with atomic create and row-locked mark_returned.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Framework-independent loan application service with Protocol ports for repository and clock, plus CSV-style loan line formatting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural ports and a frozen dataclass for ActiveLoan.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the fields a loan record must expose.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol port for supplying the current date.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol port defining the persistence operations the loan service needs.

nodes.name: ActiveLoan
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding the borrower of a currently active loan.

nodes.name: LoanApplication
nodes.summary: Application service for lending, returning, listing and looking up loans using injected repository and clock.

nodes.name: loan_line
nodes.summary: Serializes a loan to a semicolon-delimited CSV line with ISO dates.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for plain-text loan API endpoints and HTML UI pages.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views exposing loans as a plain-text API and HTMX-aware HTML pages for listing, lending and returning.

nodes.name: loan_catalog
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML list of all loans.

nodes.name: loan_catalog_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML detail page for one loan or 404s.

nodes.name: loan_collection
nodes.summary: Plain-text endpoint: GET lists loans, POST delegates to lending.

nodes.name: loan_lend
nodes.summary: Validates LoanForm and lends a book, returning 201 with the loan line or 400 with errors.

nodes.name: loan_lend_page
nodes.summary: HTML lending form page supporting HTMX partial responses and redirects on success.

nodes.name: loan_detail
nodes.summary: Plain-text loan lookup returning 404 when missing.

nodes.name: loan_return
nodes.summary: POST endpoint to return a loan, yielding 404 if unknown or 409 if already returned.

nodes.name: loan_return_page
nodes.summary: HTML return action handling HTMX status fragments, conflict errors and redirects.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires FeeApplication with the Django loan repository, system clock and HTTP payment gateway into a shared fee_application instance.

nodes.name: gateway.py
nodes.summary: HTTP payment gateway adapter that POSTs charges to a configurable URL, refuses redirects, and maps network failures to PaymentGatewayFailure.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses HTTPRedirectHandler to disable redirects; URL comes from PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL env var.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository that looks up a Loan by primary key for the fee domain.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Framework-free fee domain: protocols for ports, Fee/GatewayResponse value objects, and FeeApplication computing late fees and delegating payment.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural ports and frozen dataclasses for value objects.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing for fee and payment JSON/text endpoints and HTML UI pages.

nodes.name: view_helpers.py
nodes.summary: Helpers for fee views: currency formatting, payment gateway result mapping to HTTP status, and 404 handling for missing loans.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for viewing late fees and paying them, as plain HTML/text endpoints and template-rendered pages with HTMX partial support.

nodes.name: _NoRedirect
nodes.summary: Redirect handler that suppresses HTTP redirects so charge calls never follow them.

nodes.name: _open
nodes.summary: Opens a request using an opener that refuses redirects.

nodes.name: HttpPaymentGateway
nodes.summary: Implements the PaymentGateway port by POSTing a charge for a loan and returning a GatewayResponse or raising PaymentGatewayFailure.

nodes.name: DjangoFeeLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Finds a Loan by id via the Django ORM, returning None if absent.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the loan attributes the fee logic needs.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Port protocol for finding loans by id.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Port protocol supplying the current date.

nodes.name: PaymentGateway
nodes.summary: Port protocol for charging a loan.

nodes.name: Fee

nodes.name: GatewayResponse
nodes.summary: Immutable value object with payment gateway status and body.

nodes.name: PaymentGatewayFailure
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the gateway is unreachable, carrying the response body.

nodes.name: FeeApplication

nodes.name: format_fee_amount
nodes.summary: Formats cents as a dollar string.

nodes.name: gateway_result
nodes.summary: Pays a loan and maps outcomes to a (body, HTTP status) pair: 404, 502 or 200.

nodes.name: fee_or_404
nodes.summary: Returns the loan fee or a 404 HttpResponse when the loan is unknown.

nodes.name: fee_detail

nodes.name: payment
nodes.summary: POST view that charges the fee and returns plain-text result.

nodes.name: fee_page

nodes.name: payment_page

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Provides a SystemClock that returns today's local date via Django's timezone utilities.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Production clock adapter implementing the Clock protocol using timezone.localdate().

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the hold application with its Django repository, system clock, and the loans application as loan-state lookup.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Hold Django model with sequence ordering and a computed 30-day expiry date.

nodes.name: Hold
nodes.summary: Django model for a hold with member, ISBN, placement and cancellation dates; expires_on is placed_on plus 30 days.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM implementation of the hold repository, using a Postgres advisory lock to serialize placement and sequence-based identities.

nodes.name: DjangoHoldRepository
nodes.summary: Persists and queries holds via the ORM, with advisory-lock placement, active-hold filtering (30-day window), and transactional create/cancel.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Core hold business logic: protocols for ports, failure codes, and HoldApplication that validates and places, lists, and cancels holds.

nodes.name: HoldRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the fields of a hold record.

nodes.name: LoanState

nodes.name: HoldIdentity

nodes.name: HoldRepository

nodes.name: HoldApplication

nodes.name: hold_line

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routes for listing/placing holds and cancelling a hold.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for the holds HTTP API, translating application results and failure codes into plain-text responses.

nodes.name: hold_collection
nodes.summary: GET lists active holds; POST places a hold and returns 201 or an error response.

nodes.name: hold_cancel
nodes.summary: POST-only view that cancels a hold by id.

tour.title: Project Overview: URL Entry Point
tour.description: The app is a Django library system (loans, holds, fees, monthly reports) using ports/adapters. Start at the loans URL routing, which maps HTTP requests to views for both the plain-text API and the HTML UI.

tour.title: Loan Domain Core
tour.description: services.py is framework-free: it defines Protocol ports (repository, clock) and the LoanApplication that holds the business rules. Everything else plugs into these ports.
tour.languageLesson: typing.Protocol defines structural interfaces: any class with matching methods satisfies the port, with no inheritance needed.

tour.title: Loan Adapters and Models
tour.description: The Django ORM Loan model, repository adapter and SystemClock implement the ports defined by the domain.

tour.title: Composition Root
tour.description: composition.py wires the concrete repository and clock into a shared LoanApplication, keeping the domain free of Django.

tour.title: Web Layer: Views and Forms
tour.description: Views translate HTTP into application calls and render plain text or HTMX-aware HTML; the form validates lending input.

tour.title: Templates
tour.description: Django templates extend a base layout with DaisyUI and htmx; partials update parts of the page for lend and return flows.

tour.title: Holds Feature
tour.description: Same pattern again: HoldApplication holds the rules, an ORM repository (with a Postgres advisory lock) persists them, and the composition root reuses the loans application for loan state.

tour.title: Fees and Payments
tour.description: FeeApplication computes late fees and delegates payment through a gateway port, implemented by an HTTP adapter.

tour.title: Monthly Reports
tour.description: The reports service composes loan data and fees to produce per-member statistics, exposed through a management command printing CSV.

tour.title: Supporting Pieces
tour.description: Migrations seed the schema and sample data, the core module probes database connectivity, and library_info serves the static About pages.
